Sugarcane.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Sugarcane Research (IISR) / DES DAC&FW
Sugarcane.citation: ICAR Handbook of Agriculture (6th ed., 2011, pp. 1184-1192); Agricultural Statistics at a Glance 2021 Table 4.15
Sugarcane.evidence: Tropical ratoon record plot yields in Tamil Nadu & Maharashtra reach 140-165 t/ha; screening ceiling set at 180.0 t/ha
Sugarcane.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Fresh millable cane containing ~70-75% water. Commercial sucrose recovery 9-11%.

Banana.source_institution: ICAR - National Research Centre for Banana (NRCB), Tiruchirappalli
Banana.citation: NRCB Annual Report & Crop Production Guide 2018, Section 4.2
Banana.evidence: Tissue-culture Grand Nain under high-density drip fertigation (3,000 plants/ha) yields 80-120 t/ha; field maximum 140 t/ha
Banana.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Whole fresh fruit bunches. Edible pulp-to-peel ratio ~2:1.

Papaya.citation: NHB Indian Horticulture Database 2014, Fruit Productivity: Papaya, pp. 78-82
Papaya.evidence: Gynodioecious Red Lady 786 hybrid under intensive fertigation yields 80-120 t/ha; commercial ceiling 140 t/ha
Papaya.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Fresh commercial whole fruit at table-ripe maturity.

Tomato.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Horticultural Research (IIHR), Bengaluru
Tomato.citation: IIHR Extension Bulletin on High Yielding F1 Tomato Hybrids (Arka Rakshak / Samrat), 2017
Tomato.evidence: Triple disease resistant indeterminate hybrid field records reach 75-80 t/ha under staking and fertigation
Tomato.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Fresh ripe salad/processing fruit with ~93-95% water content.

Tapioca.source_institution: ICAR - Central Tuber Crops Research Institute (CTCRI), Thiruvananthapuram
Tapioca.citation: CTCRI Package of Practices for Cassava, Technical Bulletin 45, Table 3.2
Tapioca.evidence: High-yielding irrigated cassava varieties Sree Athulya / Sree Rekha yield 50-65 t/ha fresh tuber; screening ceiling 75 t/ha
Tapioca.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Fresh harvested cassava roots containing ~60-65% moisture and ~30-35% starch.

Cabbage.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Vegetable Research (IIVR), Varanasi
Cabbage.citation: IIVR Technical Bulletin No. 42 (Cole Crop Production Technologies), pp. 34-38
Cabbage.evidence: Commercial F1 hybrids under temperate rabi conditions produce 50-65 t/ha compact heads; ceiling 70 t/ha
Cabbage.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Fresh trimmed marketable heads containing ~90-93% moisture.

Potato.source_institution: ICAR - Central Potato Research Institute (CPRI), Shimla
Potato.citation: CPRI Technical Bulletin No. 102 (Potato in India: 75 Years of Research, 2020), Table 6.1
Potato.evidence: Rabi crop in Punjab/Haryana/Western UP with Kufri Pukhraj reaches 40-52 t/ha; commercial ceiling 60 t/ha
Potato.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Fresh marketable ware tubers (~78% water, ~20-22% dry matter).

Onion.source_institution: ICAR - Directorate of Onion and Garlic Research (DOGR), Pune
Onion.citation: DOGR Bulletin No. 18 (Varietal Performance and Production Technologies), pp. 12-16
Onion.evidence: High-yielding rabi onion varieties Bhima Super / Bhima Dark Red yield 35-48 t/ha under drip irrigation; ceiling 55 t/ha
Onion.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Field-cured dry bulbs with tops trimmed (~84-86% moisture).

Grapes.source_institution: ICAR - National Research Centre for Grapes (NRCG), Pune
Grapes.citation: NRCG Viticulture in India Technical Guide, Section 5.3 (Table Grape Productivity)
Grapes.evidence: Thompson Seedless grafted on Dogridge rootstock in Nashik/Sangli yields 30-42 t/ha; ceiling 45 t/ha
Grapes.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Fresh marketable table/wine grape clusters (~78-82% water).

Sweet potato.source_institution: ICAR - Central Tuber Crops Research Institute (CTCRI), Thiruvananthapuram
Sweet potato.citation: CTCRI Extension Bulletin on Biofortified Sweet Potato, pp. 22-26
Sweet potato.evidence: Bhu Krishna and Bhu Sona varieties produce 25-38 t/ha fresh tuber under high-input trial management; ceiling 45 t/ha

Dry ginger.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Spices Research (IISR), Calicut
Dry ginger.citation: IISR Package of Practices: Ginger, pp. 14-18
Dry ginger.evidence: High-yielding varieties IISR Varada / Mahima yield 20-30 t/ha fresh rhizome (dry recovery 20%); raw record ceiling 40 t/ha
Dry ginger.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Sun-dried cured rhizomes (~10-12% moisture). Fresh-to-dry conversion ratio ~4.5:1.

Pineapple.source_institution: National Horticulture Board (NHB) / ICAR Research Complex for NEH
Pineapple.citation: NHB Indian Horticulture Database, Commercial Pineapple Cultivation, pp. 112-116
Pineapple.evidence: Giant Kew / Queen under high-density spacing (44,000 plants/ha) yields 25-32 t/ha; ceiling 35 t/ha
Pineapple.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Fresh mature fruit with crown (~85-87% moisture).

Brinjal.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Vegetable Research (IIVR), Varanasi
Brinjal.citation: IIVR Technical Bulletin on Solanaceous Vegetable Production, pp. 28-32
Brinjal.evidence: Commercial hybrid field crops yield 25-32 t/ha under continuous picking; ceiling 35 t/ha
Brinjal.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Fresh tender marketable eggplant fruit (~92% water).

Mango.source_institution: ICAR - Central Institute for Subtropical Horticulture (CISH), Lucknow
Mango.citation: CISH Mango Cultivation Bulletin No. 28, High Density Orchard Management
Mango.evidence: Ultra-high-density orchards of Amrapali (1,600 trees/ha) yield 15-22 t/ha in mature bearing; ceiling 25 t/ha

Orange.source_institution: ICAR - Central Citrus Research Institute (CCRI), Nagpur
Orange.citation: CCRI Nagpur Mandarin Production Guide, Technical Bulletin 58
Orange.evidence: Intensive orchards with drip fertigation and Phytophthora management yield 15-22 t/ha; ceiling 25 t/ha

Garlic.source_institution: ICAR - Directorate of Onion and Garlic Research (DOGR), Pune
Garlic.citation: DOGR Bulletin on High-Yielding Garlic Varieties (Bhima Purple / Yamuna Safed-3)
Garlic.evidence: Short-day garlic under rabi bed planting yields 14-20 t/ha; commercial ceiling 25 t/ha
Garlic.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Cured dry bulbs with papery scales (~62-66% moisture).

Ginger.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Spices Research (IISR), Calicut
Ginger.citation: IISR Package of Practices: Ginger, Extension Pamphlet No. 12
Ginger.evidence: Fresh rhizome yields under heavy organic manuring reach 18-24 t/ha; ceiling 25 t/ha
Ginger.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Fresh green unpeeled rhizomes (~78-82% water content).

Bhindi.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Vegetable Research (IIVR), Varanasi
Bhindi.citation: IIVR Technical Bulletin on Okra Hybrid Seed and Crop Production, pp. 19-24
Bhindi.evidence: YVMV-resistant F1 hybrids (Kashi Kranti / Parbhani Kranti) produce 15-22 t/ha; ceiling 25 t/ha

Turmeric.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Spices Research (IISR), Calicut
Turmeric.citation: IISR Package of Practices: Turmeric (IISR Pratibha / IISR Kedaram), Bulletin 16
Turmeric.evidence: Fresh rhizome yields in Salem/Erode high-input tracts reach 16-20 t/ha; ceiling 20 t/ha
Turmeric.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Officially cured dry rhizome (Spice Board standard). Caution: local district figures occasionally conflate with green rhizome (15-25 t/ha).

Lemon.source_institution: ICAR - Central Citrus Research Institute (CCRI), Nagpur
Lemon.citation: CCRI Acid Lime Cultivation Manual, pp. 24-28
Lemon.evidence: Kagzi lime under drip fertigation yields 14-18 t/ha in mature bearing; ceiling 20 t/ha

Pome Granet.source_institution: ICAR - National Research Centre on Pomegranate (NRCP), Solapur
Pome Granet.citation: NRCP Pomegranate Production Guide, Table 4.1 (Bhagwa Variety Performance)
Pome Granet.evidence: Bhagwa orchards under drip fertigation and bacterial blight management reach 14-18 t/ha; ceiling 20 t/ha

Sapota.citation: NHB Indian Horticulture Database, Sapota Production Bulletin
Sapota.evidence: Mature Kalipatti and Cricket Ball orchards yield 14-18 t/ha; commercial ceiling 20 t/ha

Maize.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Maize Research (IIMR), Ludhiana
Maize.citation: IIMR Maize Production Technologies in India, Table 3.1; AICRP Annual Report 2019
Maize.evidence: Single-cross rabi maize hybrids in Bihar/Andhra under irrigation yield 10-13 t/ha; national demonstration peak 14.5 t/ha; ceiling 16 t/ha
Maize.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean shelled dry grain normalized to 14% moisture content.

Rice.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Rice Research (IIRR), Hyderabad
Rice.citation: IIRR Progress Report 2018 (Agronomy Section); Handbook of Agriculture, Rice Chapter
Rice.evidence: System of Rice Intensification (SRI) / hybrid rice demonstration plots in TN & Bihar yield 11-13.5 t/ha; screening ceiling 15 t/ha
Rice.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean dry grain at 12-14% moisture (DAC&FW state reported series).

Paddy.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Rice Research (IIRR), Hyderabad
Paddy.citation: Identical agronomic species (Oryza sativa) as Rice; unhusked grain equivalent
Paddy.evidence: Unhusked rough rice (paddy) ceiling matches rice grain benchmark at 15.0 t/ha
Paddy.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Rough paddy grain with husk (~13% moisture). Hull-to-rice ratio ~66%.

Guar seed.typical_commercial_range: 1.0 - 3.0 t/ha dry seed / 8.0 - 12.0 t/ha fresh pod
Guar seed.source_institution: ICAR - Central Arid Zone Research Institute (CAZRI), Jodhpur
Guar seed.citation: CAZRI Technical Bulletin on Clusterbean Technologies for Arid Regions, pp. 15-20
Guar seed.evidence: Commercial vegetable guar pod yield under irrigation reaches 12-14 t/ha; screening ceiling 15 t/ha
Guar seed.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Air-dry clean cluster bean seed (~10% moisture). Pod yield is ~4x seed yield.

Wheat.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research (IIWBR), Karnal
Wheat.citation: IIWBR Wheat Crop Management Bulletin 2020, Table 2; Progress Report 2019-20
Wheat.evidence: HD-2967 / HD-3086 in Punjab/Haryana yield 6.5-7.8 t/ha; state farm competition records reach 8.5-9.2 t/ha; screening ceiling 12 t/ha
Wheat.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean threshed wheat grain at 12% moisture. Distinct from total biological biomass.

Dry chillies.typical_commercial_range: 2.0 - 4.0 t/ha dry pod / 8.0 - 11.0 t/ha fresh pod
Dry chillies.citation: Spices Board Package of Practices for Chillies; IIHR Chilli Production Guide
Dry chillies.evidence: Fresh hot pepper pod yields under irrigation reach 10-12 t/ha (dry conversion 25-30%); ceiling 12 t/ha
Dry chillies.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Sun-dried cured ripe chillies (~10% moisture). Caution: fresh green chilli yield is ~3.5-4x dry yield.

Ragi.source_institution: ICAR - All India Coordinated Research Project on Small Millets, Bengaluru
Ragi.citation: AICRP on Small Millets Annual Report 2019, Table 2.4
Ragi.evidence: High-yielding finger millet varieties (GPU-28, ML-365) under irrigation yield 4.5-6.5 t/ha; screening ceiling 10 t/ha
Ragi.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean finger millet grain at 12% standard moisture content.

Black pepper.typical_commercial_range: 1.5 - 3.5 t/ha dry / 5.0 - 9.0 t/ha fresh green berry
Black pepper.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Spices Research (IISR), Calicut
Black pepper.citation: IISR Black Pepper Cultivation Manual, pp. 22-26
Black pepper.evidence: High-density Panniyur-1 plantations under intensive shade/fertigation reach 8-10 t/ha fresh berries; ceiling 10 t/ha
Black pepper.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Sun-dried black peppercorns (~11% moisture). Green-to-dry ratio ~3:1.

Sannhamp.typical_commercial_range: 1.0 - 3.0 t/ha clean fiber / 8.0 - 10.0 t/ha dry biomass
Sannhamp.source_institution: ICAR - Central Research Institute for Jute and Allied Fibres (CRIJAF), Barrackpore
Sannhamp.citation: CRIJAF Technical Bulletin on Sunnhemp (Crotalaria juncea) Fiber & Green Manure
Sannhamp.evidence: Sunnhemp dry stem biomass reaches 8-10 t/ha under favorable monsoon; screening ceiling 10 t/ha
Sannhamp.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Air-dry extracted bast fiber (~12% moisture). Total dry stem biomass is ~4x fiber yield.

Drum Stick.source_institution: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University (TNAU) Horticultural College
Drum Stick.citation: TNAU Agritech Portal: Moringa Cultivation (PKM-1 / PKM-2 Annual Moringa)
Drum Stick.evidence: Annual moringa selections under drip irrigation yield 250-300 pods/tree (~8-10 t/ha pods); ceiling 10 t/ha

Tea.typical_commercial_range: 2.0 - 4.0 t/ha made tea / 7.0 - 9.0 t/ha green leaf
Tea.source_institution: Tea Board of India / UPASI Tea Research Institute
Tea.citation: Tea Board of India Tea Statistics; UPASI Package of Practices
Tea.evidence: Green leaf harvests under clone B/5/63 reach 8-9 t/ha fresh green shoot; ceiling 9 t/ha
Tea.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Commercial made black tea (~3% moisture). Green leaf weight is ~4.5x made tea.

Tobacco.source_institution: ICAR - Central Tobacco Research Institute (CTRI), Rajahmundry
Tobacco.citation: CTRI Annual Report 2019, Table 3.2; Tobacco in India Monograph
Tobacco.evidence: Chewing and bidi tobacco varieties (G-6, Anand-119) produce up to 5.5-6.5 t/ha cured leaf; ceiling 8 t/ha
Tobacco.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Barn-cured or sun-cured dry leaf (~10-12% moisture).

Barley.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research (IIWBR), Karnal
Barley.citation: IIWBR Barley Crop Management Bulletin 2019, pp. 10-14
Barley.evidence: Two-row malt barley hybrids (DWRB-101, BH-902) under irrigation yield 5.5-6.8 t/ha; ceiling 8 t/ha
Barley.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean threshed barley grain at 12% moisture.

Jowar.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Millets Research (IIMR), Hyderabad
Jowar.evidence: Commercial kharif grain hybrids (CSH-16, CSH-25) under irrigation yield 5.0-6.8 t/ha; ceiling 8 t/ha
Jowar.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean grain sorghum at 12% moisture content.

Groundnut.source_institution: ICAR - Directorate of Groundnut Research (DGR), Junagadh
Groundnut.citation: DGR Groundnut in India: Research Highlights, Technical Bulletin 36
Groundnut.evidence: Summer groundnut under drip fertigation in Saurashtra (TG-37A, Kadiri-6) yields 4.5-6.2 t/ha; ceiling 8 t/ha
Groundnut.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean sun-dried pods in shell (~7-8% moisture). Shelling turnover ~70%.

Castor seed.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Oilseeds Research (IIOR), Hyderabad
Castor seed.evidence: Castor hybrids (GCH-7, DCH-519) under drip irrigation in Gujarat yield 4.5-6.5 t/ha clean seed; ceiling 8 t/ha

Bajra.source_institution: ICAR - All India Coordinated Research Project on Pearl Millet, Jodhpur
Bajra.citation: AICRP on Pearl Millet Annual Report 2019, Table 3.4
Bajra.evidence: Summer irrigated pearl millet hybrids (GHB-538, Pioneer 86M32) yield 4.5-5.8 t/ha; ceiling 7 t/ha
Bajra.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean pearl millet grain at 12% moisture.

Soyabean.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Soybean Research (IISR), Indore
Soyabean.evidence: High-yielding varieties (JS-9560, NRC-86) under optimal inputs and weed management yield 3.8-4.8 t/ha; ceiling 6 t/ha
Soyabean.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean threshed dry soybeans at 8-10% moisture.

Small millets.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Millets Research (IIMR), Hyderabad
Small millets.citation: IIMR Small Millets Production Package (Kodo, Foxtail, Proso, Little millets)
Small millets.evidence: Improved varieties under line sowing and supplemental irrigation yield 3.0-4.5 t/ha; ceiling 6 t/ha
Small millets.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean grain of minor millets (kodo, foxtail, proso, barnyard, little) at 12% moisture.

Rapeseed &Mustard.source_institution: ICAR - Directorate of Rapeseed-Mustard Research (DRMR), Bharatpur
Rapeseed &Mustard.citation: DRMR Technical Bulletin on Mustard Varieties (Giriraj / NRCHB-101), pp. 14-18
Rapeseed &Mustard.evidence: Indian mustard in Rajasthan/Haryana under three irrigations yields 3.2-4.2 t/ha; farm competition peak 4.8 t/ha; ceiling 5.5 t/ha
Rapeseed &Mustard.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean dry oilseed (Brassica juncea / campestris) at 6-8% moisture.

Linseed.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Oilseeds Research (IIOR), Hyderabad
Linseed.citation: IIOR Linseed Technical Bulletin No. 19, Table 3.1
Linseed.evidence: Irrigated dual-purpose linseed varieties (PKDL-41, Jawahar-28) yield 2.5-3.5 t/ha seed; ceiling 5.5 t/ha

Gram.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR), Kanpur
Gram.citation: IIPR Pulses in India: Varietal Profile and Technologies 2018, Gram Chapter
Gram.evidence: Kabuli and Desi chickpea hybrids (JG-14, JAKI 9218) under one irrigation yield 3.0-4.0 t/ha; ceiling 5 t/ha
Gram.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean threshed chickpea seed at 10-12% moisture content.

Sunflower.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Oilseeds Research (IIOR), Hyderabad
Sunflower.citation: IIOR Sunflower Production Technologies Bulletin, pp. 12-16
Sunflower.evidence: KBSH-44 and DRSH-1 hybrids under irrigation and boron application yield 3.0-4.0 t/ha; ceiling 5 t/ha

Arhar/Tur.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR), Kanpur
Arhar/Tur.evidence: GMS-based pigeonpea hybrid ICPH-2671 yields 2.8-3.6 t/ha under drip fertigation; ceiling 4.5 t/ha
Arhar/Tur.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean dry pigeonpea seed at 10-12% moisture.

Lentil.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR), Kanpur
Lentil.citation: IIPR Technical Bulletin on Lentil Varieties (L-4076, DPL-62), pp. 10-14
Lentil.evidence: Bold-seeded varieties under rabi irrigation in Central India yield 2.5-3.2 t/ha; ceiling 4 t/ha
Lentil.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean dry lentil seed at 10-12% moisture.

Masoor.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR), Kanpur
Masoor.citation: Identical botanical species (Lens culinaris) as Lentil; regional Hindi nomenclature
Masoor.evidence: Ceiling matches Lentil species benchmark at 4.0 t/ha
Masoor.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean dry red lentil seed at 10-12% moisture (botanically identical to Lentil).

Horse-gram.source_institution: ICAR - Central Research Institute for Dryland Agriculture (CRIDA), Hyderabad
Horse-gram.citation: CRIDA Technical Bulletin on Rainfed Horse-Gram (Macrotyloma uniflorum)
Horse-gram.evidence: High-yielding drought-tolerant varieties (CRIDA-18R, Paiyur-2) yield 2.0-2.8 t/ha; ceiling 4 t/ha
Horse-gram.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean dry kulthi pulse seed at 10% moisture.

Cashewnut.source_institution: ICAR - Directorate of Cashew Research (DCR), Puttur
Cashewnut.citation: DCR Cashew Production Technology Manual, Table 2.2
Cashewnut.evidence: High-density plantations with varieties Vengurla-4 / Ullal-1 yield 2.5-3.2 t/ha raw nuts; ceiling 4 t/ha
Cashewnut.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Raw unshelled cashew nuts with pericarp (~8% moisture). Kernel recovery ~25-28%.

Cashewnut Raw.source_institution: ICAR - Directorate of Cashew Research (DCR), Puttur
Cashewnut Raw.citation: Identical commercial product as Cashewnut in raw unprocessed nut form
Cashewnut Raw.evidence: Ceiling matches Cashewnut raw benchmark at 4.0 t/ha
Cashewnut Raw.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Raw unshelled cashew nuts (alias of Cashewnut in DAC&FW records).

Coriander.source_institution: ICAR - National Research Centre on Seed Spices (NRCSS), Ajmer
Coriander.citation: NRCSS Package of Practices for Coriander, Technical Bulletin 14
Coriander.evidence: High-yielding varieties (ACr-1, Hisar Anand) under irrigation yield 2.2-2.8 t/ha clean seed; ceiling 4 t/ha
Coriander.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Dry clean coriander seeds (schizocarps) at 9-10% moisture.

Safflower.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Oilseeds Research (IIOR), Hyderabad
Safflower.citation: IIOR Safflower Production Technology Bulletin, Table 2.1
Safflower.evidence: Non-spiny varieties (NARI-6, PBNS-12) under two protective irrigations yield 2.2-3.0 t/ha; ceiling 4 t/ha
Safflower.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean dry spiny/non-spiny safflower seed at 6-7% moisture.

Rubber.source_institution: Rubber Board of India, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Kottayam
Rubber.citation: Rubber Board of India Rubber Growers' Companion, Table on Clone Yields (RRII-105)
Rubber.evidence: RRII-105 high-yielding clone under intensive stimulation yields 2.2-2.8 t/ha dry rubber; ceiling 4 t/ha
Rubber.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Commercial Dry Rubber Content (DRC) coagulated sheet/crepe (~1-2% moisture). Raw latex is ~30-35% DRC.

Coffee.source_institution: Coffee Board of India, Central Coffee Research Institute (CCRI), Balehonnur
Coffee.citation: Coffee Board Technical Bulletin on Arabica & Robusta Productivity
Coffee.evidence: High-density Robusta (Selection 274) under drip irrigation yields 2.0-2.8 t/ha clean bean; ceiling 4 t/ha
Coffee.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean cured green coffee beans (Arabica/Robusta) at 10-11% moisture. Fresh cherry is ~5-6x bean weight.

Moong(Green Gram).source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR), Kanpur
Moong(Green Gram).citation: IIPR Green Gram Production Bulletin (IPM-02-03, Samrat), pp. 12-16
Moong(Green Gram).evidence: Summer irrigated mungbean with synchronous maturity yields 1.8-2.5 t/ha; ceiling 3.5 t/ha
Moong(Green Gram).moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean dry mungbean seed at 10-12% moisture.

Urad.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR), Kanpur
Urad.citation: IIPR Black Gram Technologies Bulletin (Pant U-31, Shekhar-2), Table 2.2
Urad.evidence: Summer irrigated urad with MYMV resistance yields 1.8-2.5 t/ha; screening ceiling 3.5 t/ha
Urad.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean dry blackgram seed at 10-12% moisture.

Sesamum.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Oilseeds Research (IIOR), Hyderabad
Sesamum.citation: IIOR Sesame Production Manual, Technical Bulletin 28
Sesamum.evidence: High-yielding varieties (Swetha, RT-351) under summer irrigation yield 1.5-2.0 t/ha; screening ceiling 3.0 t/ha
Sesamum.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean dry sesame seeds at 6% moisture content.

Cardamom.source_institution: Spices Board India / ICAR-IISR Cardamom Research Centre, Appangala
Cardamom.citation: Spices Board Production Guide: Small Cardamom (Elettaria cardamomum)
Cardamom.evidence: High-yielding clonal selections (Njallani Green Gold) under drip irrigation reach 1.8-2.4 t/ha dry capsule; ceiling 3.0 t/ha
Cardamom.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Commercial cured green cardamom capsules at 10-12% moisture. Fresh green capsule weight is ~5x dry capsule.

Niger seed.source_institution: ICAR - Indian Institute of Oilseeds Research (IIOR), Hyderabad
Niger seed.evidence: Improved varieties (JNC-6, Utkal Niger-150) under line sowing yield 1.2-1.6 t/ha; screening ceiling 3.0 t/ha
Niger seed.moisture_or_harvest_form_notes: Clean dry niger seed at 7-8% moisture.
